examples.english: The family wants a trip this week.

examples.arabic: ثم سالني فجاة عن خططي لحضور حفل زفاف ابن اخي الاسبوع القادم
examples.english: Then he suddenly asked me about my plans to attend my nephew's wedding next week.
examples.transliteration: Thumma sa'alanī faj'atan ʿan khuṭaṭī li-ḥuḍūr ḥafl zifāf ibn akhī al-usbūʿ al-qādim.

examples.english: I felt joy and will visit them again next week
examples.transliteration: Sha'artu bil-farahi wa sa'azuruhum al-usbua al-qadim

examples.arabic: قررت اسرتي وانا التخطيط لرحلة نهاية الاسبوع هذا الاسبوع.
examples.english: My family and I decided to plan a weekend trip this week.
examples.transliteration: Qarrarat usrati wa ana at-takhteet li rihlat nihayat al-usbu' hadha al-usbu'.

examples.arabic: كنت امشي في الحديقة اليوم وشعرت بالراحة بعد اسبوع عمل صعب
examples.english: I was walking in the park today and felt relaxed after a difficult work week
examples.transliteration: kuntu amshi fi alhadiqati alyawma wa shaartu bilrahati bada usbuu amalin saab

examples.arabic: ثم اتفقا على لقاء في نهاية الاسبوع لتبادل الاخبار
examples.english: Then they agreed to meet at the end of the week to exchange news.
examples.transliteration: Thumma ittafaqa ala liqa' fi nihayat al-usbu' li-tabadul al-akhbar
examples.storyTitle: An Evening Call with a Friend
